name: SideNavSwitcher

props.name: labelText
props.description: Provide the label for the switcher. This will be the first visible option when someone views this control

props.name: options
props.description: Provide an array of options to be rendered in the switcher as an `<option>`. The text value will be what is displayed to the user and is set as the `value` prop for each `<option>`.

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon SideNavSwitcher rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
